title: fix(plugin-list): every export entry in the list Display popover stays inside the panel
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQfJxYoK5tk7jy6otHhfCYg)_

Fixes #29175

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表「显示」弹窗底栏里的导出按钮单独占一行，且这一行可以换行；「重置为视图默认」和刷新按钮留在上一行。
- **为什么改**:视图提供 CSV、XLSX、JSON 三种导出时，刷新按钮和三个导出按钮挤在一个不换行的组里，比弹窗宽，「Export as JSON」被裁到弹窗外，窄窗口下直接出屏，用户看不到 JSON 导出。
- **风险与回滚**:只改一个组件底栏的布局类名，导出行为、文案、权限门控和 test id 都不变，弹窗宽度不变；回滚即还原 `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` 这一处。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` 的 footer（`display-footer` 下的 `display-export-group`），再看新测试 `ViewSettingsPopover.exportFooter-29175.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:showcase 以管理员登录，打开 Tasks › In Progress 列表，点「显示」按钮：底栏第一行是重置和刷新，下面是 CSV、XLSX 一行、JSON 换到下一行，三个按钮都在弹窗内且可点。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Display popover's footer no longer puts Refresh and the export entries in one non-wrapping group.

- **Chosen shape: the export entries get their own row.** The footer keeps Reset (left) and Refresh (right, `ml-auto`) on its first row; the export entries sit in a new full-width row (`basis-full`, test id `display-export-group`) below it.
- That row is itself `flex-wrap`, because three "Export as …" entries (about 400 px together) are wider than the panel's 304 px content box at `sm:w-80`, so on its own the row still could not hold them. With CSV, XLSX and JSON, CSV and XLSX share the first export line and JSON wraps to the next, right-aligned like the old group.
- Unchanged: the popover width, the export behaviour (`onExport(format)`), the `list.exportAs` labels, the export grant gating (the host still decides whether `onExport` and `exportFormats` are passed), and every existing test id (`display-footer`, `display-reset-button`, `refresh-button`, `display-export-FORMAT`). No i18n key, no metadata key, no gate.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ViewSettingsPopover.exportFooter-29175.test.tsx` (3 cases): renders the popover with CSV, XLSX and JSON and asserts every entry is reachable by role ("Export as CSV/XLSX/JSON"), is the `display-export-FORMAT` element, sits inside `display-export-group`, which carries `flex flex-wrap basis-full`, and calls `onExport` with its format; Refresh and Reset stay on the footer's first row, outside the export row, and the export row holds the export entries only; no export row is drawn when no format is offered.
- Ablation: with main's `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (ea150b7f) put back on disk, the first two cases go red (2 failed, 1 passed); restored by `git checkout HEAD`, hash-matched to HEAD's blob.
- Full `packages/plugin-list/` suite: see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- Phone width (375 px): the popover is `w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]`, 343 px. Measured in a real browser, the footer fits (scrollWidth 341 = clientWidth 341) and all three entries are inside the panel; before the fix the footer's scrollWidth was 440 against 341 and "Export as JSON" ran to x 441 on a 375 px viewport. Nothing else in the footer overflows there.
- The measurement used a temporary Vite entry under `ui/apps/console` that renders the real component (before = main's file, after = this branch) with the Console stylesheet, not a showcase boot; it was deleted afterwards and is not in the diff. Its "before" numbers at 1440x900 match the card's own measurement exactly (popover 1073..1393, footer 440 vs 318, JSON 1380..1514).

## Verification

Bounding boxes in Chromium, Display popover open, CSV/XLSX/JSON offered, Reset and Refresh present:

| Viewport | | Popover x | Footer scrollWidth / clientWidth | Export as CSV | Export as XLSX | Export as JSON |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440x900 | before | 1073..1393 | 440 / 318 | 1114..1240 inside | 1244..1376 inside | **1380..1514, outside, not hit-testable** |
| 1440x900 | after | 1073..1393 | 318 / 318 | 1122..1248 inside | 1252..1384 inside | 1250..1384 (second line) inside |
| 1024x768 | before | 657..977 | 440 / 318 | inside | inside | **964..1098, outside** |
| 1024x768 | after | 657..977 | 318 / 318 | inside | inside | 834..968 inside |
| 375x812 | before | 0..343 | 440 / 341 | inside | inside | **307..441, past the viewport** |
| 375x812 | after | 0..343 | 341 / 341 | inside | inside | 200..334 inside |

"Inside" means the button's box lies within the popover's box; every "after" entry is also the topmost element at its own centre (hit-tested with `elementFromPoint`).
